sms.title: Main metal price SMS
sms.subtitle: Pick one metal as your main metal and we'll text you about its price changes.
sms.locked: Main metal price SMS are for {plan} subscribers.

rule.update: Each time the day and IME prices of this metal are updated, one “prices updated” SMS (at most 3 a day).
rule.move: If a product of this metal moves 10% or more against the day before, up or down, an alert with the new price — right away; that change isn't repeated in the "prices updated" SMS.
rule.night: Nothing is sent from 22:00 to 08:00; overnight changes are announced in the morning.

sms.choosePrompt: Pick your main metal to start receiving price SMS.
sms.noPhone: This account has no mobile number, so no SMS can be sent. Sign in with an account whose username is a mobile number.
